Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt frontend-applicaties met React en Vite; bouwt nieuwe functionaliteiten voor AI-applicaties en interne webapplicaties; ontwikkelt toegankelijke, snelle en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces; werkt samen met backend developers voor de integratie van API's en AWS-services; denkt mee over de technische inrichting van de frontend en het verbeteren van de architectuur; optimaliseert performance, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid; vertaalt ontwerpen uit Figma naar pixel-perfecte interfaces; beoordeelt nieuwe functionaliteiten op technische haalbaarheid en gebruikerservaring; draagt bij aan codekwaliteit door reviews, kennisdeling en het toepassen van best practices.

rolesAndResponsibilities: You'll design and build features end-to-end. You'll influence technical direction across multiple teams. You'll bring experience to the table to influence the roadmap and guide fellow engineers. You'll challenge product ideas with technical insight and our own business ideas to enhance the ground transportation experience.

rolesAndResponsibilities: This is a founding engineer role: broad ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line from your code to customer outcomes. You'll work across the full stack on the features that make Sollo sticky: the AI sales agent, the inbox, prospecting, the CRM, and the integrations underneath them. Ship. Get working software in front of customers quickly, then iterate. Output is what matters. Build across the stack. Front-end, back-end, data, and the AI layer that powers the product. Use AI tools properly. We expect you to be excellent at building with AI (coding assistants, agents, LLM APIs) and at building AI into the product. You know where AI accelerates you and where it doesn't. Own features end to end. From a rough idea or a customer conversation through to shipped, monitored, and improved. Talk to customers. You'll understand who we serve and let their reality drive your decisions. Keep quality high where it counts. Strong attention to detail in the things customers feel, pragmatic everywhere else.
